question.wording: Does the taxpayer elect to deduct state and local general sales taxes instead of state and local income taxes on Schedule A line 5a?

options.label: No — deduct state and local income taxes
Yes — deduct general sales taxes instead (check the box on line 5a)

default.because: Schedule A line 5a takes state and local income taxes unless the taxpayer elects general sales taxes; no election has been recorded.

citation.wording: If you don't elect to deduct general sales taxes, include on line 5a the state and local income taxes listed next.
